title: Ensemble runner: runner.yaml
description: This computer's runner: a worker that runs the tasks its hub keeps for the git repositories of its workspace with the helper teams in its teams directory, and, through the hub, lends this computer's power. In ~/.config/ensemble/runner/runner.yaml; a computer runs one runner. Nothing has a default value; `hub` and a block under `offers` that are left out are not used.

name.description: Its name, which a hub knows as <owner>/<name>: letters, digits, '-', '_' or '.'.

access.description: private: it works for its owner alone. shared: also for everyone whose role has `compute`; connecting it needs `host`. A shared runner offers only agents that run on llm_backends, never on an agent CLI's subscription.

workspace.description: The folder it works in, such as ~/ensemble. Each git repository directly inside it is a project, named for its folder: the runner runs the tasks the hub keeps for it, and finds a repository added later within half a minute. ~/ is the home directory; a relative path is beside runner.yaml.

hub.description: The hub server it connects to, ws:// or wss://, signed in to with `ensemble runner login`: the tasks the hub has for you, and what it offers. Leave it out for no hub.

offers.description: What it offers through a hub server. `{}` offers nothing.

interfaces.description: How it is managed: each interface it turns on. Left out, the command line is on; at least one must be.

cli.description: `ensemble hub …` or `ensemble runner …` on its computer, run by the running process over its socket when it runs.

runs.description: Agents of the runner's teams, which others name with an agent of `type: node`. A run gets a copy of the files git tracks, works in a folder of its own, and sends back what it changed.

agents.description: Which agents may run here, as <team>/<agent>.

models.description: Models an OpenAI-compatible server on this computer serves, reached through the hub at https://<hub>/nodes/v1 with an access token as the API key.

base_url.description: The server's OpenAI-compatible base URL, such as http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1.

api_key_env.description: The environment variable holding the server's API key, when it needs one.

timeout_seconds.description: The most one request may take.

names.description: The models offered, as the server names them.
